project_overview: CCTNS V1.0 is a police case management system designed to improve crime investigation and criminal detection processes.

actors.name: Admin
actors.description: System administrator with full access rights

actors.name: Citizen
actors.description: Public user reporting cases or accessing public data

functions.name: TrackDefect
functions.description: Track system defects and enhancement requests

functions.name: ViewReports
functions.preconditions: User must have report viewing permissions

constraints.description: Provide context-sensitive help for all UI actions
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all the possible actions and scenarios on all user interfaces in the application.
The solution should provide an interface for the user to log any defects or enhancement requests on the application and track thereafter.

The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word "unalterable" is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.

constraints.description: Allow access restriction to specific users/groups
constraints.source_text: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

constraints.description: Only admins can set up user profiles
constraints.source_text: The System must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.

constraints.description: Search results must respect access rights
constraints.source_text: If a user performs a quick or advanced search, the System must never include in the search result list any record which the user does not have the right to access.

The interfaces must be made customizable or user-configurable to the extent possible. (e.g., the displayed columns in the table, move, resize, modify the appearance). Such configurations must be saved in the user profile.

The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system. In this context, performing a search means returning a result list. It does not include retrieving the records themselves.
The system should support multilingual interface
The system should use HTTPS as the communication protocol, i.e., HTTP over an encrypted secure socket layer (SSL)
Prevent cross-site scripting
Prevent SQL Injection
Do not allow hard delete and perform only soft tagging the row for deletion
Use of cache for storing frequent data
The search results should be fetched from the database in batches of 10 or 20 maximum as configured within the application

The search should fetch only the fields that need to be displayed to the user. Only when the user clicks on a particular record to view its further details should a query be fired to fetch the additional details for this particular record only

constraints.description: Apply database indexes on search columns
constraints.source_text: Database Indexes should be applied on the key columns used for searching

constraints.description: Export audit trails for specified cases
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to export audit trails for specified cases (without affecting the audit trail stored by the System). This functionality can be used by external auditors who wish to examine or analyse system activity.
The system should provide for role-based control for the functionality within the system
The System must allow a user to be a member of more than one group.

constraints.description: Allow users to specify access rights
constraints.source_text: The System should allow a user to stipulate which other users or groups can access cases.

All error messages produced by the System must be meaningful, so that they can be appropriately acted upon by the users who are likely to see them. Ideally, each error message will be accompanied by explanatory text and an indication of the action(s) which the user can take in response to the error.
The System must employ a single set of user interface rules, or a small number of sets to provide a familiar and common look and feel for the application.
The System must provide End User and Administrator functions which are easy to use and intuitive throughout.

user-definable values; values same as previous item; values derived from context, e.g. date, file reference, user identifier; The System must allow persistent defaults for data entry where desirable. These defaults should include:

constraints.description: Design frequent transactions for minimal interactions
constraints.source_text: Frequently-executed System transactions must be designed so that they can be completed with a small number of interactions (e.g. mouse clicks).

menu contents; layout of screens; use of function keys; on-screen colours, fonts and font sizes; Where the System employs a graphical user interface, it must allow users to customise it. Customisation should include, but need not be limited to the following changes:
The user interfaces should be designed to make them user-intuitive.
The user interfaces of the system should comply with Standard ISO 9241.

constraints.description: Support offline mode for critical functions
constraints.source_text: The system should work even in an offline mode with the critical functionality
The system should be designed to have satisfactory performance even in Police Stations connected on low-bandwidth
The system should be implemented using Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) and have a modular design
The system should be developed on Open Standards
The system should be built on a common User Access and Authentication Service to ensure Single-Sign on for the end-user
The system should be developed for a centralized deployment and maintenance
The system should be developed to be deployed in a 3-tier datacenter architecture

constraints.description: Use n-tier architecture with separation of concerns
constraints.source_text: The system should be designed to have a n-tier architecture with the presentation logic separated from the business logic that is again separated from the data-access logic
The system should be extensible to provide access to the interfaces through PDA's and mobile data terminals
The system should adopt standardized formats and common metadata elements

constraints.description: Support browser-based access with minimal client requirements
constraints.source_text: The system should be designed for access through browser-based systems and must impose minimal requirements on the client device
The system must support multiple types of communication services for remote access

constraints.description: Support public access to subset of data
constraints.source_text: The system should have capability to support public access to a subset of data and functionality
The system should support multi-tier authentication where required
The system should support SSL encrypted connections
The system should support secure virtual private network connections
The system should run on multiple browsers

constraints.description: Ensure audit trail data is available for inspection
constraints.source_text: The System must ensure that audit trail data is available for inspection on request, so that a specific event can be identified and all related data made accessible, and that this can be achieved by authorised external personnel who have little or no familiarity with the system.
The System be scaleable and must not have any features which would preclude use in small or large police stations, with varying numbers of cases handled.
The System must provide adequate response times for commonly performed functions under both standard and peak conditions
Validate the incoming data / user request
Encode the incoming data / user request
Utilize parameterized queries
Sanitize the user-inputs

constraints.description: Validate data at client and server
constraints.source_text: Validate the data both at the client and server
Use of AJAX based technology to improve user experience.
Aggressive page loading to be considered based on the screen and estimate usage pattern
Leverage Asynchronous HTTP socket capabilities of web server for scalability and performance

constraints.description: Host static content on web server
constraints.source_text: Host all the static content (documents, images) on the web server
Display of records on the screen in batches/paged manner

constraints.description: Use hierarchical cache for frequent searches
constraints.source_text: A hierarchical cache should be configured and used for caching of results of most frequently used searches

constraints.description: Ensure audit trail accessible to external personnel
constraints.source_text: The System must ensure that audit trail data is available for inspection on request, so that a specific event can be identified and all related data made accessible, and that this can be achieved by authorised external personnel who have little or no familiarity with the system.
The solution should enable the user to track the submitted defect or enhancement request.
The solution should enable the help-desk user to view the reports on the submitted defects or enhancement requests category-wise, status-wise, and age- wise.
The support solution should be accessible to the users both from within the application and also outside the application through a browser interface.

exceptions.trigger: User attempts to access case without permission
exceptions.handling: Log attempt in audit trail and show configured response

exceptions.trigger: Search takes longer than allowed time
exceptions.handling: Show timeout message and suggest refining search

non_functional_requirements.description: System must perform simple searches within 5-8 seconds and advanced searches within 10-15 seconds
System must maintain unalterable audit trails and prevent unauthorized access
System must provide intuitive interfaces with context-sensitive help
System must be available during specified hours with minimal downtime
System must scale to support varying numbers of cases across police stations
